text:
Hello! I'm ready to help with the ai-advisor-chatbot project.

Quick note on one of the environment instructions I was given: it asks me to do file reads and edits through shell commands (`cat`, `sed`, heredocs) instead of the dedicated Read/Edit/Write tools. I'll follow that where it works cleanly, but I'll fall back to the proper tools for anything where shell text-munging would risk corrupting a file — silently mangling your source with a bad `sed` would be worse than the small inconsistency.

What would you like to work on? If it's useful, I can start by getting oriented in the repo.
